about: Touched-path → test-suite map, read by `botq test-map`. First matching rule wins; `tests: []` means consciously untested and must carry its why.

rules.why: every object of the pinned wunderkammer-objects builds and loads and runs within its program budget through the overlay host's own object path

the effect and look-field names the overlay's expression reader admits are the ones the catalog's publish guard admits: the reader's build checks each is a variant it reads, the guard's test that it refuses any other

the overlay host's build runs its unit tests and offscreen-render tests on a software Vulkan device, and wraps the runtime libraries SteamVR's client needs; the headset bundle's build checks its architecture, loader, libraries and glibc floor; the simulated controller driver builds
the script writes the page's golden render that the overlay host's build compares its own render against
the script writes the page spotter's golden that the overlay host's build compares its own features, scores and decisions against
the script writes the page speaker filter's golden that the overlay host's build compares its own features, detections and gate decisions against
the script writes the page turn judge's golden on public speech clips, checked against Smart Turn's reference inference, that the overlay host's build compares its own judgements against

tests: nix-shell -p python3 imagemagick libwebp oxipng --run 'python3 test/pack-puppets.py'
rules.why: Exercise exact transparent texels, required WebP extension, sparse morph decoding, and unchanged untextured models.
the catalog install refuses a file that carries less than the one it replaces, on synthetic files
the real embedding model must reach every action token from natural conversational sentences; the golden script also runs these sentences for the native overlay host to compare its classifier against

Classifier changes must pass real-model embedding invariance and action evaluation as well as browser coverage; the native overlay host reads the page's labels, instructions and decisions from the golden this file writes, and pins its embedding model by the name exported here.
the mocap converter writes the licensed capture clips the server serves; its test checks the retarget against the capture's own joint directions
the rest pose and the moods' faces are read by the page and compiled into the native overlay host
the speaker filter is run by the page and read by the native overlay host, which parses its constants, pins its model and compares against its golden
the turn judge's features, constants and model pin are run by the page and read by the native overlay host, which parses its constants, pins its model and compares against the page's golden
the wake spotter, its models, the demo model, the trainer and the phrases are run by the page and compiled into or compared by the native overlay host
the script builds a voiceprint file from recordings; the speaker tests cover the choice of the voice it keeps
the page's recorded delegated-reply sessions are judged by the page tests and replayed against the native client by the overlay host's build
browser assets, build inputs, smoke measurements, baseline, and gate configuration must pass the same browser smoke as CI; display coverage includes table rows, inline links, and pipes inside code
